name: How can I tell if my faucet needs repair or replacement?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my faucet needs repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your faucet is relatively new and only requires a simple part replacement, repair is often the most cost-effective option. However, if the faucet is old, severely corroded, frequently leaks despite repairs, or if replacement parts are difficult to find, a full replacement might be more economical in the long run. A plumber from Alpha-Plumbing Services can inspect your faucet and recommend the best course of action based on its condition and the extent of the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider repair for minor issues on newer faucets; replacement might be better for old, frequently leaking, or severely corroded faucets.
